products.name: LG 10 kg AI Direct Drive top-load washing machine with TurboDrum
products.shortName: 10 kg AI Direct Drive top-load washer
products.summary: Lift the tempered glass lid, pull out the detergent drawer and look into the TurboDrum, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: 100.3 cm tall with the lid shut; with the lid open it is 127.5 cm
specs: Inverter Direct Drive, AI DD and 6 Motion DD
TurboDrum, TurboWash, JetSpray, Side Water Fall
Semi stainless steel, embossed inner drum
Normal, Quick Wash, Hard Water, Soak + Normal, Tub Clean, AI Wash, Gentle, Duvet, Spin Only, Downloaded
LED with 18:88 figures, delay end 3-19 hours
LG ThinQ (Wi-Fi): remote start, Smart Diagnosis, energy monitoring
Cold only inlet; 10 water levels, 5 spin levels, rinse up to 5 times

hotspots.title: AI Direct Drive
hotspots.text: Auto detects the fabric type & weight and optimises every wash. Detects not only the weight, but also senses the softness of fabric, and it chooses the optimal motions for the fabric by itself.

hotspots.title: Water Resistant Control Panel
hotspots.text: Designed for damp environments with an IPX4 rating. The high waterproof rating and rear-mounted controls ensure lasting durability.

hotspots.title: TurboDrum
hotspots.text: TurboDrum™ for powerful wash: the drum and the pulsator turn in opposite directions for a strong water stream.

hotspots.title: Bigger Detergent Box & eZMix
hotspots.text: Bigger detergent box & eZMix ensure even detergent-softener mix for effortless washing and lasting fabric softness.

fit.note: From LG's owner's manual: leave 10 cm behind the machine and 2 cm on the left and right. The lid swings up and back: LG gives the height with the lid open as 127.5 cm, so keep 27.2 cm free above it.
